title: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 Review: A Half Marathon at Dataran Merdeka
seo_title: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 Review | KL Dataran Merdeka Race
meta_description: Pos Malaysia Run 2026: November 29 at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur. 21K, 10K, and 5.5K with registration open — Malaysia's postal-service road race reviewed.
dek: Set for 29 November 2026 at Dataran Merdeka — Kuala Lumpur's historic independence square — this Pos Malaysia Berhad-organised run offers three distances with registration open. A national-brand road race at one of KL's most iconic venues.
verdict: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 is a national-brand road race at Dataran Merdeka, the historic square where Malaysian independence was declared. Organised by Pos Malaysia Berhad, the country's postal service, it offers three distances (21K, 10K, 5.5K) with registration open. The venue is the real draw: running through the heart of colonial KL with the Sultan Abdul Samad Building as your backdrop. A solid, accessible half marathon option for Klang Valley runners.

sections.heading: The Venue: Dataran Merdeka
paragraphs: Dataran Merdeka is KL's most historically significant public space — the site of the 1957 independence declaration, flanked by the Sultan Abdul Samad Building and the Royal Selangor Club. [1] For a road race, it provides a grand start/finish precinct with wide surrounding boulevards through the colonial district.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you're in the Klang Valley and want a well-organised, historically-set half marathon with open registration, Pos Malaysia Run is a solid pick. The 2026 edition is set for 29 November at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur. [1]
